conviction_note: Zero: the cause is identified and fully documented (Brazil's 25 Sep betting ban, quantified by the company at 09:00 ET today), the two-day fall is close to the capitalised value of the lost Brazil EBITDA at this levered name's multiple so there is no mechanism-backed overshoot, and the one dated catalyst (the STF ruling on suspending the ban) cannot land before the AGU's 72-hour response window closes on 1 Oct, after this window ends.
bar: The company's own number: Q4 2026 revenue about $3M lower if the ban holds to year end (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/29/3370953/0/en/inspired-provides-update-on-brazil-regulatory-developments.html). Checked against the Q2 10-Q: $60.8M quarterly revenue, £252.5M ($335.1M) SONIA+5.5-6.0% notes due 2030, $22.0M cash, 26.36M shares, and senior secured net leverage 2.91x against a 5.0x covenant (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1615063/000149315226036164/form10-q.htm). Rough arithmetic, not a sourced figure: about $12M a year of Brazil revenue, roughly 7-9% of the $112-118M EBITDA guide at a digital margin. At about 3.5x EV/EBITDA that is about $25-30M of EV, and the two-day equity loss from about $4.57 to $3.35 is about $32M.

cause.label: litigation_or_regulatory
cause.what_happened: Brazil's President Lula signed a provisional measure on Fri 25 Sep 2026 banning licensed online betting and casino, with sites blocked from 6 Oct. INSE fell 12.69% on Mon 28 Sep. At 09:00 ET today Inspired said substantially all its Brazil revenue is affected, put the Q4 revenue hit at about $3M, and said it will update its FY2026 outlook at Q3 results. BWS Financial downgraded Buy to Neutral the same day and put Brazil at up to 15% of revenue. The stock fell a further 16% intraday to the 15:04 ET screen.

evidence.claim: Inspired: substantially all Brazil revenue affected, Q4 revenue about $3M lower if the shutdown holds to year end, FY outlook to be updated at Q3 results, no reversal assumed
Lula's provisional measure bans fixed-odds betting and online casino. Sites go offline 6 Oct. Congress has 120 days to act
BWS Financial downgrades INSE from Buy to Neutral on the Brazil ban and estimates Brazil exposure at up to 15% of revenue
Seeking Alpha: 'Inspired Entertainment slides after Brazil's ban on online betting'

pipeline.next_dated_event: The AGU's 72-hour window to answer the ANJL/IBJR petition before Justice Fux closes on 2026-10-01, so an STF ruling on suspending the ban can come no earlier than that, after this window. Brazil's first-round election is 2026-10-04 and sites are blocked from 2026-10-06.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: Justice Fux granting an injunction or Congress's leaders moving to return the provisional measure before the 30 Sep close would be a dated positive inside the window; a Form 8-K (Item 2.06 impairment or 7.01 guidance) filed tonight would be a dated negative.

positioning_check: Short interest was 1,190,762 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, 6.93 days to cover, up 9.3% from the 08-31 settlement (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/INSE/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That is about 4.5% of 26,358,372 shares outstanding at 2026-07-31 (10-Q). This predates the ban. The position carried into the fall is not observable, and the 09-30 settlement publishes around 10-09, outside the window. There is no skew: the Oct-16 chain is not two-sided at the money, total open interest is 149 and the put/call OI ratio is 0.38. Insiders made 17 open-market buys and 6 sells over 12 months (Nasdaq insider-trades), but quarter-end is 30 Sep, so no in-window buyer can be asserted.

outside_window.finding: STF (Justice Fux) ruling on the ANJL/IBJR and Anseja petitions to suspend the Brazil ban, or to grant existing licensees a 6-month or 180-day wind-down. The AGU's 72-hour response window runs to 1 Oct, so no ruling can land before that. A suspension would restore most of the ~$3M a quarter; a refusal confirms the base case the company already assumes.
Congress must convert, amend or let the provisional measure lapse within 120 days. Reports say Congress is already organising to change or overturn it. Two-sided, and dated well past the window.

The FY2026 outlook ($112-118M adjusted EBITDA) will be revised at Q3 results. The company says it is not assuming the ban is reversed, so a guide cut is expected; its size beyond the ~$3M of Q4 revenue is the open question. The date is a Zacks estimate, not company-announced.
Brazil sites are blocked on 6 Oct and refunds are processed 9-14 Oct. This is the physical end of Brazil revenue, and the company release already assumes it.

searched_and_found_nothing: 8-K/A of 2026-09-23 (Item 5.07): only the say-on-pay frequency decision from the May meeting, unrelated to the fall. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1615063/000149315226043935/form8-ka.htm
EDGAR submissions: no 8-K filed for the Brazil update (latest 8-K is 2026-08-18), so no open four-business-day clock is visible. https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001615063.json

Full-text 'Brazil', 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-29: hits only in the 10-K, the 10-K/A and a Nov 2025 exhibit, with no disclosed Brazil revenue share. https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q="Brazil"&ciks=0001615063
Supply: the baseline probe found no at-the-market or lock-up language in the last 550 days and no minimum-bid-price language ever. Nothing can be drawn tonight.

Solvency: covenant headroom is 2.91x against a 5.0x max senior secured net leverage at 6/30/26, the notes mature 2030, and liquidity is stated as sufficient through Aug 2027 (Q2 10-Q). Losing about $10M of annual EBITDA does not approach the covenant, and there is no test date inside the window.

Analyst pipeline: only BWS (downgrade, 9/29) found. MarketBeat lists 3 covering analysts (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/INSE/forecast/). No Craig-Hallum, Truist or Macquarie Brazil note found, so a count of cuts still to land cannot be sourced.
Buyback: $19.4M left on the $25M authorisation (Q2 10-Q), but no evidence of activity inside the window and quarter-end is 30 Sep. Not assertable as a buyer.

Brazilian Congress: party leaders had not met on next steps as of 9/29, and nothing is dated inside the window. https://jornalpequeno.com.br/2026/09/29/congresso-articula-mudancas-na-mp-que-proibe-bets-no-brasil/
The European Gaming article on the ban's deadlines returned 403. https://europeangaming.eu/portal/latest-news/2026/09/28/214894/brazil-online-betting-ban-european-operators/
No price, quote or chart after the 15:04 ET screen instant was seen. The BWS article quotes an intraday $3.61, which is before the screen and was not used in any number.
baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline. There is 5.1x volume and a second consecutive heavy fall on a fully disclosed, quantified regulatory loss, and the company's own number roughly equals the equity value the stock has shed given 3.5x EV/EBITDA leverage, so the document gives neither an overshoot nor a hidden second shoe inside the window. With no in-window finding, the name's -4.47% own-history median (n=2, one of which is yesterday) and its 9.5% ATR are left to the free controls rather than restated as research.
